name: LAUNCHXL-F2800137 LaunchPad development kit
sources: TMS320F2800137 product page and datasheet (features list, 2026-10-06); LaunchPad user guide SPRUJ32 (board parts, switches, J101, FAQ)

columns.head: The chip: F2800137
items: Built for control math. 120 million steps a second (120 MHz). Not Arm: TI's own compiler, no Zephyr
Hardware for decimals and for sine, cosine and divide, the math motors need
Holds the program. Kept when the power is off
Working memory while it runs. Cleared at power off

columns.head: Connections inside the chip
items: Fast on-off signals that set motor speed and power-supply output
Measure a voltage, 0 to 4095 steps, up to 4 million times a second
Shut a PWM off in hardware when a current gets too high
Read a motor's position / time an incoming pulse
Serial text / fast bus / sensor bus / the car and factory network
Plain on/off pins: LEDs, buttons, control lines

columns.head: On the board, and missing
items: USB debug probe (XDS110), CAN and encoder connectors, reset button, LEDs
2 wires only (cJTAG), through the J101 jumpers
No Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, no USB of its own
